# Ailytics

> Ailytics adds AI video analytics to the CCTV cameras a site already owns, detecting safety, security and productivity risks on construction sites, plants, ports, airports and yards, with real-time alerts and compliance reporting.
> Born in Singapore in 2019, Ailytics runs on 400+ projects worldwide, deploys on the edge, on-premise or in the cloud, and goes live in under 2 weeks.
> Last reviewed: 2026-10-26.

## Product

- [AI video analytics for construction and heavy industries](https://www.ailytics.ai/): Learn what Ailytics detects, how it measures 3D distance from one camera, and how alerts reach site teams.
- [Use cases](https://www.ailytics.ai/use-cases): Browse 50+ detections for safety, security and productivity that run on existing cameras.
- [PPE detection](https://www.ailytics.ai/use-cases/ppe-detection): See how missing hard hats, vests and gloves are flagged with evidence for supervisors.
- [Industries](https://www.ailytics.ai/industries): Find the hazards Ailytics monitors in construction, manufacturing, oil and gas, logistics, ports, airports and data centers.
- [Construction](https://www.ailytics.ai/industries/construction): Understand how construction sites use AI video analytics for struck-by, lifting, open-edge and PPE risks.
- [ChildSafe Vision](https://www.ailytics.ai/childsafe-vision): Learn how preschools use AI on existing CCTV to detect supervision gaps and review incidents.
